commit_note: APK built from c0de572 (settings resume-refresh fix, HEAD at journey time); the receipt and evidence land as the following docs-only commit.
apk_variant: debug (release signing still blocked on the owner keystore per handoff.md — unchanged by this work)

fixture.install: clean streamed install, then ime enable + ime set of biz.pixelperfectstudios.personaspeak/com.menny.android.anysoftkeyboard.SoftKeyboard

listener_opt_in.notes: Granted through the product's own flow: settings home card -> Suggested replies screen (Off) -> prominent-disclosure consent gate -> system 'Device & app notifications' screen -> 'Allow notification access for AnySoftKeyboard Dev?' -> Allow. dumpsys notification lists biz.pixelperfectstudios.personaspeak/biz.pixelperfectstudios.personaspeak.ime.reply.ReplyNotificationListener in Allowed notification listeners (component string matches the manifest). The command path (adb shell cmd notification allow_listener <component>) was also verified, rc=0.

message_ingest.notes: adb emu sms send injected a real SMS through Google Messages; the platform posted a MessagingStyle notification (EXTRA_MESSAGES with sender_person + text, verified via dumpsys --noredact). The listener parsed it and the chip appeared — no synthetic post fallback needed.

chip_surface.notes: 'Replying to: (555) 123-4567 · Messages' chip with 'Draft →' affordance renders in the strip while Resting (10_keyboard_chip_replying_to.png).

suggest_offline_fake.notes: Three persona-flavored suggestions from FakeProvider (offline, no credentials configured or used) in the active persona (Jeeves) + mood (Polite); replies interpolate the actual message topic and vary across messages (11 vs 14/16).

regenerate.notes: Regenerate issues a fresh suggest call (15b). Same-message output is identical by design — FakeProvider is deterministic per topic; ViewModel re-invocation is pinned by ReplySuggestionsViewModelTest.

apply_one_mutation.notes: Tapping suggestion 1 on an empty editor inserted exactly the chosen draft ('Right away — consider “Running late, start the tea without me” handled.' — visible with the app's 63-char counter) via EditorPort.insertDraft; exactly-one-mutation and the empty/non-empty routing are pinned by EditorPortContractTest, RewriteCoordinatorTest, and ReplySuggestionsViewModelTest.

forget_on_apply.notes: Chip disappeared immediately after apply (12); it returned only when a new message arrived (13). Dismiss, by contrast, keeps the context (15).

rtl_locale_pass.notes: Per-app locale set to [ar] (verified via cmd locale get-app-locales) and the journey re-run with a fresh message; the IME strip did not mirror. Consistent with the M7 finding: per-app locales apply to activities, while the IME window renders with the system locale on API 34. The strip uses start/end padding throughout, and the settings screens' RTL behavior is unchanged from the M6 pass; a mirrored-device pass remains open as follow-up work.

dark_light_pair.notes: Light strip (10/11) and dark strip (16, via cmd uimode night yes) both render with correct surfaces and legibility.

sanitization: All message text in evidence is synthetic (injected via adb emu sms send); no real person's content and no credentials appear anywhere in the receipts, screenshots, or uidumps.
deviations: rtl_locale_pass: IME strip does not mirror under per-app ar locale on API 34 (M7 finding reproduced); recorded rather than faked.

The app was reinstalled mid-journey to ship the settings resume-refresh fix discovered on-device; the notification-access grant survived (install -r), and the opt-in flow evidence was captured on the pre-fix build with identical UI (the fix only adds the ON_RESUME re-probe).
